description: Validate & standardize a US address, returning deliverability, corrected components, and a confidence score. Pass either a single freeform `address` string OR structured `primary_line`/`city`/`state`/`zip_code`. Non-mutating (no mail sent). Lob API: POST /v1/us_verifications.

address.description: Freeform single-line address (alternative to the structured fields).

primary_line.description: Primary delivery line, e.g. '210 King Street'.

name: lob_verify_us_address
title: Verify a US address
